description: A lightweight Fabric mod that adds configurable Next Hotbar Slot and Previous Hotbar Slot keybindings for Minecraft.

mods.name: HotbarBumpers
mods.description: A client-side mod that will enhance the Minecraft hotbar.

releases.notes:
Initial Release
HotbarBumpers 1.0.0 is the first public release of the mod.

Features
- Adds Next Hotbar Slot and Previous Hotbar Slot keybindings.
- Fully configurable through Minecraft's Controls menu.
- Uses Minecraft's native hotbar selection logic for vanilla behavior.
- Client-side only.
- Lightweight implementation with no unnecessary mixins.

Requirements
- Minecraft Java Edition 26.2
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

Thank you for checking out HotbarBumpers! If you encounter any bugs or have suggestions for improvements, please open an issue on GitHub.
